# iaas_lb_waf_policy (Resource)

Manages the Web Application Firewall policy of a load balancer (a singleton child). load_balancer_id is part of the API path; changing it forces a new resource. Import with the load balancer id. Requires a load balancer plan with the waf capability enabled.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the WAF is active.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) UUID of the parent load balancer. Part of the API path; changing it forces a new resource.
- `mode` (String) Inspection mode: "off", "detect" (log, pass) or "block" (deny matched).

### Optional

- `crs_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the managed core rule set (default true).
- `exclusions` (List of Number) Managed rule ids to exclude from evaluation.
- `fail_mode` (String) Agent-fault behavior: "open" (default) or "close".
- `full_audit` (Boolean) Write heavy per-transaction audit detail (default false).
- `response_inspection` (Boolean) Inspect response bodies (default false).
- `sensitivity` (Number) Rule sensitivity level 1-4 (default 1). Higher catches more but risks more false positives.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the WAF policy, assigned by the API.
